# flexsae

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ridsonap/flexsae/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ridsonap/flexsae/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
<!-- badges: end -->

**flexsae** is an R package, under development, for small area estimation with
area-level data (direct estimates with known sampling variances) when the
covariates act non-linearly.

Available:

- `pspline_sae()`: semiparametric Fay-Herriot model with penalized splines
  (fitted by REML or ML with 'mgcv'), with parametric bootstrap MSE.
- `merf_sae()`: Fay-Herriot model with a random forest for the fixed part
  (replacing or correcting the linear predictor), with parametric bootstrap
  MSE.

Planned for the first release:

- `select_flexsae()`, `benchmark_flexsae()` (benchmarking to aggregate targets,
  including the MSE of the benchmarked estimates), and `autoplot()` methods.

Every method is checked against the linear Fay-Herriot model of the `sae`,
`emdi` and `fastsae` packages, and in simulation studies that also report the
settings where the flexible models do worse.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ridsonap/flexsae")
```
